codeReview.summary: The landed work only covers part of the requested redesign. Reports still use the old filter/preview/export flow instead of report cards with Generate buttons, the new PDF/CSV chips are static and untranslated, and the fertilizer-plans screen fabricates schedule status from array order while adding selector/FAB affordances that do not do anything.

issues.description: VAL-REPORTS-001 is still missing. The screen continues to render the existing `ReportFiltersPanel` + preview/export stack (`ReportExecutiveSummary`, `ReportDocumentBody`, `ReportExportActions`) rather than the required bordered report cards with 42px icon circles and per-card `Generate` buttons. Evidence: app/reports.tsx:423-507 still wires the old flow, and report-filters-panel.tsx:722-740 keeps a segmented control instead of report cards.

VAL-REPORTS-002 is only approximated visually and does not preserve i18n. The added PDF/CSV chips are decorative `Pressable`s with no `onPress`, no active-state state management, and no connection to export behavior, while `t('reports.exportAs', 'Export as')`, `t('reports.dateRange.from', 'From')`, and `t('reports.dateRange.toLabel', 'To')` rely on hardcoded English fallbacks because those keys do not exist in `src/i18n/locales/en.ts`, `hi.ts`, or `mr.ts`. Evidence: report-filters-panel.tsx:667-717 plus repo search showing no locale entries for those keys.

VAL-FERTPLAN-001 is not data-driven. `getPlanItemStatus()` explicitly uses placeholder logic (`0 => completed`, `2 => overdue`, everything else upcoming`), and the left-strip / badge colors are derived from that fabricated value rather than fertilizer-plan data. This changes behavior instead of preserving the existing data flow. Evidence: app/fertilizer-plans.tsx:12-17 and 271-274; the underlying type at src/types/fertilizer-plan.ts:1-12 has no status field to support these badges.

The new farm-selector chip and FAB are inert affordances. Both are rendered as `Pressable`s without `onPress`, and the selector can display `farms[0].name` even when no `farmId` is present even though `useFertilizerPlan` disables fetching unless `farmId` is truthy. That can show a selected-looking farm without actually loading its plan. Evidence: app/fertilizer-plans.tsx:61-71, 89-114, 377-396; src/hooks/use-fertilizer-plan.ts:6-13.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The mission asks for fertilizer-plan status badges and category strips, but the shared docs do not mention that the fertilizer-plan model only exposes `name`, `quantity`, and `unit`. That gap makes it easy for workers to invent placeholder status logic instead of escalating the data mismatch.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: src/types/fertilizer-plan.ts:1-12 defines no status/category metadata; app/fertilizer-plans.tsx:12-17 adds a comment acknowledging the new status logic is placeholder-only.

summary: Review failed. Reports never received the required card-and-generate-button redesign, the new export chips are static/untranslated, and fertilizer-plan statuses are fabricated from item order instead of real data.
